prose: A magazine feature on AI researchers leaving labs. It opens with Jacob Coxon, a 27-year-old Anthropic capabilities researcher, who posted a resignation statement on September 8 protesting what he called the company's suicidally reckless pursuit of AGI. The piece also draws on Daniel Kokotajlo, Alex Turner and others about AGI's dangers and planned IPOs. Only the opening was read.
highlights: Coxon quit Anthropic on Sept 8 in protest.
Includes voices such as Kokotajlo and Turner.
